gaps.lead: Simon really ought to make a decision about his future.
gaps.sentence: It's high time Simon ___ about his future.
gaps.hint: it's high time + past; make a decision = make up one's mind
gaps.explanation: 'It's high time' takes the past subjunctive: 'made up his mind'.

gaps.lead: Although she was exhausted, she carried on working.
gaps.explanation: despite/in spite of + -ing: despite being exhausted.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: I can't deny that I was embarrassed to be given the award.
gaps.sentence: There's ___ embarrassment at being given the award.
gaps.explanation: 'There's no denying my embarrassment' = I can't deny I was embarrassed.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: A committee is looking into the sudden rise in food allergies.
gaps.sentence: The sudden rise in food allergies ___ a committee.
gaps.hint: phrasal verb in the progressive passive
gaps.explanation: 'A committee is looking into X' becomes the passive 'X is being looked into by a committee'.
